title: Harness diet-score-guard: CLAUDE.md too fat
desc: Warns/blocks when CLAUDE.md diet-score is below target (bloated/drifted), because it loads every session and a fat instruction file taxes all future context. Slim it via md-heal.
steps: TRIGGER: fires when the project CLAUDE.md diet-score is under 80 -- too long, drifted, or history-heavy in the always-loaded instruction file.
FIX: run the heal -- wkappbot skill read md-heal (and claudemd-slim-plan) -- tier it, move history to refs, replace verbose sections with skill pointers. Raising the score clears the gate.
WHY: CLAUDE.md is per-session context; bloat burns tokens on every load for every model. See: claudemd-slim-plan, claude-md-guide.
author: claude
